info.title: Jobseeker API
info.description: Personal-use API with no authentication or authorization. All POST requests require Idempotency-Key. Mutations use optimistic versions. Unknown fields are rejected. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD; timestamps require an offset. PATCH omits unchanged fields and uses null to clear optional fields.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Globally unique per operation. Identical retries return the original successful response; changed content returns 409.

file.description: Readable PDF or DOCX, maximum 10 MiB by default

Statistics.description: All counts share the dashboard's application filters. Current reasons exclude superseded/unassigned entries and use the current rejection episode. Per-category application counts are distinct; categories and sources can overlap.
